basic_details.job_title: KEA Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 36 Lecturer, Kannada Lecturer and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Kannada Lecturer, English Lecturer, History Lecturer and 5 more
basic_details.short_information: Karnataka Examinations Authority, Bengaluru (KEA) has invited applications for 36 posts in 8 roles under Advt No. ಇಡಿ/ಕೆಇಎ/50/ನೇ.ವಿ./2026(ಕೆಕೆ). The posts include Kannada Lecturer, English Lecturer, History Lecturer, Economics Lecturer and 4 more. The online application is open from 26 November 2026 to 25 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online only. Last date to pay the fee: 26 December 2026.

exam_pattern.details: Offline-OMR type examination in February 2027; detailed timetable later on the website Negative marking: one-fourth (0.25) of the marks deducted for each wrong answer 0.25 marks deducted for each question where no option (including the 5th option) is shaded Five extra minutes after the last bell to shade the 5th option for unanswered questions

how_to_apply: Open the KEA website https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/ and select the link provided for this recruitment.
Fill in the application online; details cannot be changed or corrected at any stage after submission.
Enter the correct RD number of the caste or reservation certificate in the online application.
Upload a recent photograph (JPEG, white background, 50KB to 200KB) and signature (JPEG, 50KB to 70KB).
Pay the fee online only, by 26-12-2026.
important_instructions: Admit card to be downloaded from the KEA website; bring it with one original photo ID Exam centre cannot be changed for any reason KEA will not correspond with candidates; queries must give application number, post/subject, full name in capitals and postal address Balija and its sub-castes must claim 3(A) reservation; 2(A) certificate for education will not be considered Married women of Category 2A/2B/3A/3B must obtain income certificate in husband's name by the last date Fee once paid is not refundable
